setTargetEnable: . Set a target to enable purchase quantities.
littlePartHome: A little part of your home
chooseLocationItem: Choose a location for this item before this stock write can be retried.
chooseTrueHome: Choose what is true at home. Lumio will update the household state.
correctObservedNow: Enter what you observe now. This records a correction and keeps the original Add Item history.
chooseObservedLocation: Which location or part did you check?
correctionLocationUnavailable: A stock location is missing from Item Detail. This item cannot be corrected here until its placement is available.
unlocatedStockWarning: Some batches have no location. Choose only a location you observed; unlocated batches cannot be corrected through this checklist.
missingStatePlacement: The API has no location ID for part of this item's state. Only choose a listed part you observed; the unplaced part cannot be corrected through this checklist.
eligibleOpenedStock: Eligible opened stock is used first. Lumio opens eligible packages only when needed.
lumioChoosesEligible: Lumio chooses the eligible package and batch.
removeActiveInventory: Remove from active Inventory. Stock, batches, and history are retained; active stock actions become unavailable.
stockHistoryRetained: Stock and history are retained. See the saved batches and activity below.
serverSaysFinish: The server says this Finish opened action can be undone.
serverSaysAction: The server says this action can be undone.
serverSaysState: The server says this state change can be undone.
preferenceAffectsFuture: This preference affects future stock writes. Existing batch locations stay as recorded.
useOnlyOne: Use this only when one primary unit equals one complete package. Existing positive unopened stock must be whole packages.
actionAlreadyUndone: This action was already undone. Stock and activity were refreshed.
actionUndone: Action undone. Stock and activity were refreshed.
backupOpenedStockUpdated: Backup opened and current stock updated.
lifecycleSavedRefreshWarning: Saved, but some views could not refresh. Reload to check Inventory and Shopping.
archiveBlockedGuidance: Archive was not saved. Remove this item from each active trip explicitly, then choose Archive again.
lifecycleOutcomeUncertain: The result is uncertain. Reload Item Detail and check history before trying again.
deleteCannotUndo: Permanently deleting {{name}} cannot be undone. The item and its linked history will be removed only if the server confirms deletion is allowed.
deleteSavedRefreshWarning: The item was permanently deleted, but some household views could not refresh. Reload Inventory to verify.
deleteNameMismatch: The name must match the item’s current name exactly. No request was sent.
deleteNameChanged: The item name changed. Its detail was refreshed; review the current name and enter it again.
deleteNoLongerArchived: This item is no longer archived. Refresh Item Detail before continuing.
deleteOutcomeUncertain: The delete result is still unclear. No retry was sent. Check Archived Items and Item Detail, then choose Delete permanently again only after review.
deleteOutcomeStillPresent: The item still appears in Archived Items and Item Detail. No retry was sent. Review its state before choosing Delete permanently again.
deleteConfirmationInvalid: The delete confirmation was invalid. Refresh Item Detail and enter the exact current item name.
deleteBlockedShoppingEntry: This item is still referenced by a Shopping Trip entry. Deletion is blocked; the trip entry and item history were left intact.
deleteBlockedStockCheck: This item has stock-check history. Permanent deletion is blocked; its records were left intact.
deleteBlockedUndo: This item has Undo history. Permanent deletion is blocked; its records were left intact.
deleteBlockedStockAction: This item has stock actions beyond its initial stock. Permanent deletion is blocked; its history was left intact.
deleteBlockedStockProvenance: The item has stock records whose origin does not meet the deletion contract. Permanent deletion is blocked; all records were left intact.
deleteNotificationInFlight: A notification for this item is being processed. Permanent deletion is blocked for now; check again after it finishes.
deleteReferenceChanged: A linked record changed while deletion was being checked. Nothing was removed. Refresh the item and review its history before trying again.
